title: Travel Protection Plans: Limits Standard for a Settled Benefit
content:
The limit a benefit claimed carries, when a settlement is rated on a Travel Protection Plans certificate, is read from the benefit the insurer allowed on its last decision and from the certificate's own particulars.

## The plan's amount for the benefit allowed

| Benefit allowed on the last decision | The plan's amount for that benefit |
| --- | --- |
| Lost or damaged baggage | The plan's baggage loss benefit per insured traveller |
| Baggage delay | The plan's baggage delay benefit per insured traveller |
| Travel delay | The plan's travel delay benefit per insured traveller |
| Missed connection | The plan's missed connection benefit per insured traveller |
| Emergency medical | The plan's emergency medical benefit per insured traveller |
| Emergency dental | The plan's emergency dental benefit per insured traveller |
| Evacuation and repatriation | The plan's evacuation benefit per insured traveller |
| Rental vehicle damage | The plan's rental vehicle damage benefit per rental |
| Trip interruption | The plan's interruption share of the declared trip cost |
| Cancellation for any reason | The plan's reimbursement share of the declared trip cost |
| Any other benefit, trip cancellation included | The plan's cancellation share of the declared trip cost |

## How the limit is then taken

Where the benefit allowed is one the plan states as an amount for each insured traveller and the certificate names more than one insured traveller, the limit the benefit claimed carries is the plan's amount for that benefit.

Where the benefit allowed is one the plan states as a share of the declared trip cost and the certificate declares a trip cost above nothing, the limit the benefit claimed carries is that share of the declared trip cost.

Where neither holds, the limit the benefit claimed carries is the plan's amount for that benefit taken once for each insured traveller named on the certificate.

| Benefit allowed | Certificate | Limit the benefit claimed carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One the plan states as an amount for each insured traveller | Names more than 1 insured traveller | The plan's amount for that benefit |
| One the plan states as a share of the declared trip cost | Declares a trip cost above nothing | That share of the declared trip cost |
| Neither of those | — | The plan's amount for that benefit taken once for each insured traveller named |

## Read through on hypothetical figures

On a plan whose amount for the benefit allowed is 1500.00 USD, a certificate naming 3 insured travellers where the benefit is one stated as an amount for each insured traveller carries a limit of 1500.00 USD. A certificate naming a single insured traveller reaches neither of the first two cases, so its limit is 1500.00 USD taken once for that 1 traveller, which is 1500.00 USD. Where the benefit is one the plan states as a share of the declared trip cost and the certificate declares 9000.00 USD, the limit is that share of 9000.00 USD.
